card.name: Detect/identify verbs in standard label phrases
card.fires_on: Low values on 'detect', 'identified' and 'these' in fixed label sentences, where the next idea is finding or noticing something. Examples are 'prevent and detect abuse', 'has not identified differences' and 'emergence of these symptoms'.

modes.label: Detect abuse or diversion
modes.description: The word 'detect' in the controlled-substance sentence about preventing and detecting abuse or diversion.
modes.example: Contact local state professional licensing board or state controlled substances authority for information on how to prevent and<< detect>> abuse or diversion of this product.

modes.label: Emergence of these symptoms
modes.description: The word 'these' after 'emergence of' in the suicidal thoughts warning.
modes.example: consider whether the emergence of<< these>> symptoms in any given patient may be related

modes.label: Has not identified differences
modes.description: The word 'identified' in the geriatric-use sentence about differences in response.
modes.example: Other reported clinical experience has not<< identified>> differences in responses between the elderly and younger

card.writes: It suppresses Chinese words for finding, locating and identifying, so it seems to damp those verbs; the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It marks spots in label text where the wording is about detecting or identifying something.
